package.description: Quick diagnostic tool that checks the health of your drive.

en-US.description: Quick diagnostic tool that checks the health of your drive.
en-US.longDescription:
SeaTools is a graphical tool for managing hard drives and SSDs on Windows systems. It displays drive information such as model, capacity, disk usage, temperature, and lifetime, monitors drive health, shows SMART attribute and identification information, maintains an event log, and performs firmware updates. The Health tab runs quick, extended, and long self-tests, while the Advanced, Erase, and Utility tabs provide drive configuration, secure erase, and bootable media tools.
Use this Windows version of the SeaTools GUI to diagnose hard drives and monitor SSDs. SeaTools supports all drives, though not every feature is available for non-Seagate drives.
en-US.name: SeaTools

zh-CN.description: 该快速诊断工具可检查硬盘的运行状况。
zh-CN.longDescription:
SeaTools 是一款在 Windows 系统上管理和诊断硬盘与固态硬盘的图形化工具。它显示型号、容量、磁盘使用率、温度和寿命等硬盘信息，监控硬盘健康状况，显示 SMART 属性和识别信息，维护事件日志，并可执行固件更新。「运行状况」标签页可运行快速、扩展和长期自检，「高级」「擦除」「实用工具」标签页则提供硬盘配置、安全擦除和创建可启动介质等功能。
使用此 Windows 版 SeaTools GUI 诊断硬盘并监控固态硬盘。SeaTools 支持所有硬盘，但并非所有功能都适用于非希捷硬盘。
